_about: Shot plan for baseline_shoot.py: the neutral (no Look Grade, no LUT) reference set the Looks Lab is built from. Edit freely; run 'python baseline_shoot.py TAG --dry-run' to see the resulting matrix and count before queueing it.

times._note: One row per shot time. 'hour' is what you edit. 'period' is only the row's name in the lab; the real Scene Manager period weights are computed from 'period_model' and written to the manifest (a row inside a blend shows in both period layers). In this setup 07:00 is still dark, sunset colour peaks about 18:00-18:25 and it is dark by 18:50.

Dawn.note: first light; Scene Manager: about 90% Dawn, 10% Sunrise (pure Dawn 06:00-07:00 is still dark here)

Sunset.note: peak sunset colour; about 99% Sunset (pure Sunset 17:00-18:00, then blends to Dusk until 19:00)

Dusk.note: after-glow, nearly dark; about 84% Dusk, 16% Sunset (pure Dusk 19:00-20:00 is already night-dark here)

period_model._note: How the fork's Scene Manager turns the game hour into period weights (SceneSettingsManager.cpp: GetPeriodStartHours, GetBlendedPeriods, FindBlendPeriod, GetTimeOfDayFactors). 'starts' come from the active climate: SkyrimClimate as overridden by NAT-ENB.esp keeps the vanilla timing (sunrise 5:30-10:00, sunset 16:00-20:30) and fDaytimeColorExtension is assumed vanilla (0.5). Not read from the running game: check once in the CS Editor.

sky._note: mode 'types_json': apply each sky type's Physical Sky / fog / ambient values from the pass-3 types file on top of the saved settings (Day values plus the override of the dominant period), like sky_sweep.py --stock with sweeps/pass3_types_*.json. mode 'scene': set only weather and hour and let an installed pack drive the sky (use this once the cloud pack is installed).

1.note: fair-weather half: can be shot now

2.note: after the storm / overcast / snow / fog skies are fixed

views._note: UNVERIFIED framing: free camera at the WhiterunOrigin spawn looking where the player faces. Check the first shot and set an explicit yaw.
UNVERIFIED framing (spawn point of the Bannered Mare).
UNVERIFIED framing (spawn point of Bleak Falls Barrow).

interior_matrix._note: Interior and dungeon views do not follow the outdoor matrix: they are shot once per listed time, with the first sky type of the stage as the outdoor weather (windows).

neutral._note: What makes a shot neutral for the lab: the two stages after tone mapping that the lab replaces are OFF. The script sets and reads these back before every shot and aborts on a mismatch.
